extracto: A move only counts as tradeable if it's a genuine outlier against that baseline: a z-score measured against the last InpStatsSampleCount window of returns, 3.0 standard deviations by default. Two modes ship with it. Momentum trades with the burst direction. Reversion trades against it. take-profit at 0.35x ATR, stop-loss at 0.55x ATR
alarmas: this is one backtest period, tuned and tested against itself
